subject: Pilot billing: request Net45 + temporary credit drawdown

Cc: accounts@blueharbor.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing request — Net45 & temporary credit drawdown

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — the team is excited to move the pilot into production. A couple of billing items came up on our side that I wanted to surface so we can keep the launch timeline intact:

- Net terms: Can Redwood accommodate Net45 for the pilot invoices? Our procurement prefers Net45 for initial vendor proofs while we validate usage patterns.
- Credit drawdown: To avoid disrupting the rollout, we’re requesting a temporary credit increase to $250,000 to cover the first two months of expected consumption (we will autorenew by PO).
- VAT/tax routing: We will be invoiced from our EU subsidiary (Blue Harbor EU Sàrl). Please confirm whether Redwood can issue invoices with a reverse-charge annotation; we will supply VAT registration numbers.

We can provide the PO (attached) and a one-page forecast. If there are forms or a credit application you need, point me to them and I’ll get them back to you today.

Attached: PO_78921.pdf (stub), BH_pilot_forecast_Q4.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Sophie

Subject: Re: Pilot billing request — Net45 & temporary credit drawdown

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and for sending the PO/forecast. We want to move quickly to avoid any disruption to your pilot. A few items from our side to get an interim arrangement in place:

1) Conditions for interim Net45 (90 days):
   - We need the PO on file (received).
   - First pilot invoice must be paid within 30 days of issuance to qualify for the Net45 pilot window.
   - We require a signed MPA amendment (DocuSign link below) that documents the temporary terms.

2) Credit drawdown request:
   - Please complete the attached credit-application-form.pdf (attached stub).
   - Finance can provision a temporary drawdown of up to $150,000 pending credit review. We will revisit after 60 days with usage and payment history.

3) VAT / invoicing entity:
   - We can invoice Blue Harbor EU with a reverse-charge note, but we need your EU VAT ID and a signed EU tax certificate. If invoices should be in EUR, confirm preferred currency and whether Redwood should gross-up tax.

Next steps: please return the completed credit form and the EU VAT cert. I’ve CC’d Marissa (Finance) to begin the credit review and Karthik to update the HubSpot deal and billing record. If everything looks good we’ll issue an adjusted invoice and finalize the DocuSign amendment.

Docs: credit-application-form.pdf (stub) | DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning?env=na1&acct=00000000&u=abcd1234

Thanks — I’ll keep this on a fast track.

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the VAT cert/PO. Summary and approved interim plan from Redwood:

- Net45: Approved for a 90-day pilot window starting with the first invoice issuance. This is conditional on the first invoice being paid within 30 days (per our earlier note).
- Temporary credit: We can provision a $200,000 temporary credit facility (reduced from the requested $250k) while Marissa and Finance complete the formal credit review. We’ll re-evaluate after 60 days and can expand if payment history and usage justify it.
- VAT handling: Redwood will issue invoices to Blue Harbor EU Sàrl in EUR with the reverse-charge annotation. Please confirm the exact legal entity name for the invoice (as it appears on the VAT cert) and we’ll include your EU VAT ID on the invoice.
- Invoice content: Please ensure PO number appears on every invoice to avoid processing delays; we’ll include your requested reverse-charge statement.

Action items:
- Sophie: confirm legal invoice name and confirm the DocuSign amendment signature completed.
- Blue Harbor: return the completed credit-application-form.pdf if you haven’t already; controller’s filings are optional for now.
- Marissa / Finance: please prepare an amended pilot invoice (EUR) and apply the temporary $200k credit hold so Karthik can update billing in HubSpot.

I’ve attached a draft amended MPA (amended-MPA-redwood-ds.pdf stub) for signature. DocuSign link again: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning?env=na1&acct=00000000&u=abcd1234
HubSpot deal: deals/DEAL-98765

Marissa / Karthik — please confirm when the credit is registered and the first invoice is queued so Sophie can expect it and route internally.

Thanks everyone — we’ll aim to keep the pilot live and payments flowing.
